about: Batch 6 PR2 (fix/batch6b): the output changes made on purpose, compared with 1aed58a by `bash scripts/golden-check.sh 1aed58a full --expect tests/golden_expect/batch6b.json --items kl3,b5`. KL3's MASK_VERSION 7 -> 8 and B5's gitleaks config show: B5's content checks and B6 change nothing else in the golden boxes (no gitleaks hits or key blocks there), and KL6 needs a kept roll-call answer the boxes don't have. Codex round 1 (10): each KL3 entry names its scenarios exactly, so it must be met in every output its key_rx names in each of them (an unmigrated scenario or copy is unmet), and the engine cache entry needs every cache entry's masked 7 -> 8 (json_each).

entries.why: MASK_VERSION 7 -> 8 (KL3, #15 medium 6): the marker says every approved copy was masked again by version 8

MASK_VERSION 7 -> 8: each approved copy is re-masked and records version 8; the copy is parsed and must be exactly the same apart from that field (no copy's text may change), in every copy of every scenario named (the scenarios with approved copies: not the empty account, crash or tierC)
MASK_VERSION 7 -> 8: every engine cache entry is re-masked and records version 8, nothing else changes (one entry left at 7 is no match)
